# v2.59-dev Release Notes

## New: export the whole Compliance Planning page as one report

Compliance Planning (**Programs › Compliance Planning**) could previously only
export its two tables one at a time. There's now an **Export report** button in
the page header that downloads the **entire plan** as a single file:

- **Summary** — the KPI totals (People to certify, Easy wins, Lapsed, Legacy,
  Net-new, Renewals at risk) plus the scope and renewal window.
- **Roadmap** — every requirement gap across your selected programs
  (specialisation, have / need, the gap, and the candidate pools).
- **Who to certify** — the candidate list.
- **Renewals at risk** — the renewals list (included only when there are any).

Pick **CSV**, **Excel**, or **PDF**:

- **Excel** puts each section on its own sheet.
- **PDF** stacks each section as a headed table across pages.
- **CSV** writes one file with the sections one after another under their titles.

The existing per-section **Export** buttons on the "Who to certify" and
"Renewals at risk" tables are unchanged, for when you just want that one table.

### Under the hood

This is built on a new reusable multi-section export foundation, so other report
pages can adopt whole-page exports later — and it already has a hook for
embedding charts into the PDF in a future update.
